evidence.r1: Navigation, configuration, Reserve and the lens menu use glass; sensor, lens, body and price cards are opaque.
evidence.r2: The lens menu opens above the configure bar without glass overlap, and its selected row has a plain fill.
evidence.r3: Brand navigation, section navigation, configuration, Reserve and a temporary lens chooser form a small functional set.
evidence.r4: Navigation, configuration and lens menu share one dark frosted material appearance.
evidence.r5: No clear material is apparent; the controls have dense dark frosting over the dimmed camera photographs.
evidence.r6: Orange Fitted and finish-selection labels accompany the tinted Reserve action in the scrolled views.
evidence.r7: The normal configure bar visibly picks up backdrop variation and becomes flat grey with reduced transparency.
evidence.r8: Cards and menus have fixed rounded corners, Reserve is a capsule, and dense selectors are rounded rectangles.
evidence.r9: The inset navigation selection and lens-menu row follow their enclosing rounded forms without visibly pinched corners.
evidence.r10: Reserve uses a capsule outline, while compact finish and lens controls use desktop rounded rectangles.
evidence.r11: Section links share one navigation background, and configuration is separated from the Reserve action.
evidence.r12: Navigation and finish controls are text actions; lens icons and chevrons are parts of labelled controls, not separate icon buttons.
evidence.r13: The configure material encloses the complete selector group rather than its inner text and symbols.
evidence.r14: The finish and lens options form one shared surface, with a deliberate gap before Reserve.
evidence.r15: The sensor and lens text passes behind the fixed top and bottom controls without a visible scroll-edge effect.
evidence.r16: In the scrolled views the configure bar sits directly over the flat olive content cards.
evidence.r17: The bottom configure bar covers lens and body content in the resting scrolled captures.
evidence.r18: The dark controls are readable, but no light appearance establishes the required contrast in both modes.
evidence.r19: The reduced-transparency controls remain readable, but increased contrast and reduced-motion behaviour are not demonstrated.
evidence.r20: Camera photography fills the window beneath the floating navigation and bottom purchase controls.
evidence.r21: The lower sensor, lens and body sections do not clear the fixed controls, which obscure their content.
evidence.r22: Navigation and purchase surfaces have no separate visible backing plate; the camera dimming belongs to the full content image.
evidence.r23: The open lens-menu still cannot establish its morph, materialisation or pointer press feedback.
evidence.r24: The lens and body sections use orange selected-control labels rather than monochrome control content.
evidence.r25: Light navigation and configuration labels stay distinct from the dark photography and olive cards behind the material.
